subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled as a hosted Molty deployment/state repair, or is there still an OpenClaw source path that can emit dotted Anthropic ids or ignore provider selections from Brain & Keys?
rationale: The reporter's hosted evidence is strong, but the current checkout's normal UI/gateway path appears to send provider-qualified catalog ids, so an owner must inspect the deployed hosted payload and stored state before a safe source fix can be chosen.

options.title: Verify and repair hosted Molty
options.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request path, migrate stale stored selections, and redeploy or refresh the hosted catalog if the bug is deployment/state drift.

options.title: Add a narrow source regression
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this source path, add UI/gateway coverage that prevents labels or full dotted Anthropic ids from reaching provider requests and ensures provider changes persist.

options.title: Route to hosted support
options.body: If usemolty.com is outside this repository's source ownership, keep the issue as hosted-ops tracking until recovery proof is available.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair hosted Molty
recommendation.body: Inspect the deployed Brain & Keys save/request path, migrate stale stored selections, and redeploy or refresh the hosted catalog if the bug is deployment/state drift.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both Claude Opus 4.8 support and recent session-control work.
